node.title: Re^2: How does strict determine if something is legally declared? (import)
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
Sorry for the necromancy, but I was wondering if anyone knows if and where this is documented? I've so far struck out on [doc://strict], [doc://perlmod], and [doc://perlref]... did I just miss it, or is it not there?

Update: As suggested by [jdporter], now posted as a root node here: [id://1230603] - Update 2: That thread didn't reveal any official documentation on the matter either.
